title: Wizardry 7: Crusaders of the Dark Savant

aztec_begin.note: DS.EXE's $begin saves CS:PSP in a code-segment word instead of calling _exitinit_, and ends by jumping to a DOS-exit routine with AL set instead of pushing the code and calling _exit_; the debugger entry ($dbgentry) is not linked in.

edits.find:
xor	ax,ax
	push	ax		;Croot or caller should call _exit
	call	_exit_		;but just in case...

retip	dw	0
retcs	dw	0

	public $dbgentry
$dbgentry proc far
	pop	cs:retip
	pop	cs:retcs	; save return address into debugger
	pop	ds		;set DS
	call	caller
	jmp	dword ptr cs:retip ; return to debugger
$dbgentry endp

caller	proc
	push	di		;CS value of local function
	push	si		;IP value call local function
	db	0cbH		;far return instruction
caller	endp

data_pointers.note: cursor save-buffer pointer (CS 0x1bfd -> file 0x1afd, a 0x480-byte buffer): loaded as `mov si, word [cs:cseg_1ad5]` (0x1838, 0x184a, 0x1860, 0x1876) and handed to leaf_loc_PUST, which copies from it with `rep movsb` (0x18b1) under DS = CS; it is also added to a row offset (`add ax, word [cs:cseg_1ad5]`, 0x0a33, 0x2c37). Its partner cseg_1ad7 (CS 0x207d, the second buffer) is proven by the scorer's own consumer scan (leaf_loc_KNIM 0x0bb3). The scan stops at a call, so this one is stated here

immediate_pointers.note: `mov bx, 0x33b3`: the nibble table leaf_loc_OHGP translates through with `cs xlatb` (0x3254). Handed in bx to leaf_loc_TTKL, which reaches that `cs xlatb` only past a conditional jump, so the automatic scan stops short
`mov bx, 0x33b3; add bx, word [bp + 0xc]; mov word [cs:bx], 0xff` (0x3210): an entry of the same 0x32b3 table, indexed by an argument the scan cannot prove is an index
`mov si, 0x2602`: the four 0x100-byte plane buffers at 0x2502 that io_loc_QMLN adds to si (0x2f7a). si is overwritten by `xor si, si` (0x2cb2) before any read
`add si, 0x2602`: the caller passes si = plane * 0x100 (0x2cb2-0x2cc9) and sets DS = CS (0x2cb0); the sum is read as `mov al, byte [si]` (0x2fa8)

`add di, 0x24fd` after `mul bx; mov di, ax`: a row of the 0x80-byte mask buffer at 0x23fd (filled at 0x2d2a), later written by `rep movsb` under ES = CS (0x2dbc). The `inc di` loop's backward jump ends the automatic scan
`mov bx, 0x257d`: the scratch row at 0x247d, built with `mov byte [bx], ah` (0x2d8e, DS = CS since 0x2d28) and copied out of as `mov si, cseg_247d` (0x2db6). A backward jump ends the automatic scan
`sub bx, 0x257d`: the end pointer into the 0x247d row minus its start, the byte count copied at 0x2dbc

`mov di, 0x36dd`: the 0x28-byte bit row at 0x35dd (cleared by `lea di` at 0x36ac). Handed in di to leaf_loc_NOSG, which sets bits as `or byte [cs:bx + di], al`; a [bx + di] read names no single pointer register
`mov di, 0x3705`: the 0x19-byte bit row at 0x3605 (cleared by `lea di` at 0x36b7), handed to leaf_loc_NOSG as 36f7
`mov ax, 0x3705; mov word [bp - 0x36], ax`: read back through the frame slot as `mov bx, word [bp - 0x36]; mov al, byte [cs:bx]` (0x3dcf)
`mov ax, 0x36dd; mov word [bp - 0x34], ax`: read back by leaf_loc_VGLT as `mov bx, word [bp - 0x34]; mov al, byte [cs:bx]` (0x3c19)
as 3af9

immediate_pointers.note: `mov bx, 0x1a3a`: the CS address of the 0x193a byte table the timer handlers read with `mov bx, 0x1a3a; cs xlatb`. bl is overwritten by `mov bl, 0x48` before any read, so no use proves it
`mov di, 0x1a3a`: the table this routine fills as `[cs:bx + 0x1a3a]`; di is saved/restored around it and never read
`mov si, 0x1b3a`: the table this routine reads as `[cs:si + 0x1b3a]`; si is overwritten by `mov si, ax` before any read
`cmp bx, 0xe3a`: the end of the eleven 5-byte records at 0x0d03 that the loop walks from `mov bx, cseg_0d03` with `add bx, 5`
